in_sanskrit.name: सौरभ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root सौ (sau) meaning 'fragrance, pleasure, good, auspicious' and the suffix रभ (rbh) meaning 'having, possessing'. Thus, Saurabh means 'having a fragrant, pleasing, delightful nature'.

in_hindi.name: सौरभ
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, Saurabh is also understood to mean 'subtle, refined, and profound'. The word 'sukshma' in Hindi refers to something that is subtle and refined, while 'rightaa' means profound. Thus, Saurabh can also be interpreted as 'possessing a subtle, refined, and profound nature'.

in_tamil.name: சௌரப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Saurabh is translated as 'delightful, pleasing'. The Tamil word 'விழித்தல் (viziththal)' means 'pleasing, delightful'.

in_telugu.name: శౌరభ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, Saurabh is translated as 'auspicious, good'. The Telugu word 'శోదేశ (shodeSha)' means 'auspicious, good'.

in_marathi.name: Saurabh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiance of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saurabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘sa’ (meaning good) and ‘ravi’ (meaning sun), Saurabh is a name that evokes the radiance and power of the sun god. In Hindu mythology, Saurabh is a title of the sun god Surya, and is also the name of a legendary sage and a warrior king. This name is believed to bring good fortune, courage, and strength to those who bear it.
